explanation: Anchor a line at each point and count other points by normalized slope. Count duplicate coordinates separately and combine them with the most common slope through that anchor.
timeComplexity: O(n² log C) arithmetic work with coordinate magnitude C; O(n²) for fixed-width gcd costs
spaceComplexity: O(n) slope counts and suffix slices
